verdict: The materials are the onboarding's own (the serif, the didone numerals, the hairline ledger), so nothing reads cheap, but the frames are still assembled rather than composed: every screen stacks two or three near-equal subjects down the same left edge, then lets 40 to 55 percent of the page fall away as leftover cream, where the benchmark beats bracket their emptiness between one monument and one anchor (beat 10: headline high, dark pill at the foot). Home is a well-set statistics page wearing a headline; becoming's cover is a memo floating over a void, with zero imagery on the app's emotional center. Designed at the token level, engineered at the level of the frame.

compositions.composition: One monument, bracketed void, ledger foot. Masthead: the date eyebrow alone at 13pt caps with its sparkle terminal, nothing else. Top third: the kept line at 64-72pt over two lines (snap the / next plate.) with the italic punch on next, one 17pt subline, then the 44-48pt hollow seal centered beneath the rule. Middle: 260-320pt of deliberate cream, empty on purpose because it is bracketed. Foot: a three-row didone ledger pinned above the tab bar (860 of ~1,473 · overnight fast, counts tomorrow · steps, 6,420) at 88-96pt row height, values 32-34pt, full-width hairlines. Eye path: monument, silence, foundation; beat 10's bracket built from beat 19's rows.

The last line of the day. Top third: closing the day. at 56-64pt, alone. Middle: the day's ledger in the same 92pt grammar (protein 62 of 90g · tomorrow, a balanced day · snap a meal, still open), the open kept line living as a row with its hollow seal rather than as a second hero. Foot: one italic question (how did today feel?) over a single hairline carrying three bare serif words, proud · okay · tender; tapping strikes and fills the word, the cross-off gesture she already learned in onboarding. The optional note is a bare underline that accepts type. Nothing boxed anywhere.

A cover, not a memo. Bottom 60 percent: her most recent plate photograph full bleed to three edges, a cream gradient rising into the masthead; becoming at 44pt italic and the week eyebrow sit in the cream, and the week's thesis (this week: protein earlier in the day.) sets at 52-56pt in cream ink on the photograph's quiet zone, beat 13's grammar inverted. Weeks with no photo run the monumental alternative: the week folio as a 160pt didone numeral (2 of 20) at optical center with finding steady in italic beside it. Fore-edge ticks move to the trailing edge, vertical, active tick deep rose.

Captures 04 and 05 are byte-identical to the cover, so the spreads never presented; this is the grammar they must meet. One figure per spread, hung like a plate in a monograph: eyebrow (SPREAD II · WEIGHT), one 120-140pt didone number as the subject (74.2 with a 28pt italic unit), the figure (trend line, mounds) drawn full bleed edge to edge at 30-40 percent of frame height in 1.5pt rose ink with two ghost endpoints (jun, now) and no other axis furniture, then a single 20pt italic caption like a plate caption. Nothing else; the void sits between number and figure, not after them.

A correspondence column. Keep the typeset thread: jeni in cocoa at 21pt on a ~30ch measure with 1.45 leading, her replies right-set in rose. Date breaks become small centered eyebrows inside the column (· MONDAY ·) so the masthead stays timeless. The foot sheds its chrome: the input is a single hairline rule with talk to jeni… in 19pt ghost italic, typed words set in ink directly on the rule, and send is a small ink sparkle at the rule's right that gains weight when text exists. The page then holds exactly one non-typographic object, the tab capsule.

checklist_iconic.diagnosis: The kept line is built from the right materials (serif line, hairline rule, seal) but at section-header scale: ~46pt sharing its frame with a ~70pt numeral and a solid cocoa camera disc, so a screenshot reads as a handsome stats header, not as THE object. The seal, the only state-bearing element, is a 20pt ghost at the end of the rule, so the ceremony of keeping is invisible; and because exactly one line ever shows, the frame contains no visible system of days, no evidence it is a checklist at all.
checklist_iconic.proposal: The ledger of kept days. Today's line at 64-72pt over its rule, 44-48pt hollow seal centered beneath. Above it, yesterday's line at 22pt and 35 percent opacity, struck through with a 1.5pt rose rule, its seal filled: onboarding's strike-the-statement gesture recast as the mark of a kept day. Below, tomorrow's line as a 20 percent ghost. Keeping today: the rose strike draws across the monument in ~400ms, the seal fills, one soft haptic, then the line contracts upward to join the struck stack while tomorrow's ghost inflates to 72pt and takes the frame. The screenshot becomes unmistakable, a giant serif sentence being struck through in rose above a spine of struck, sealed days, and it needs nothing beyond cocoa serif, rose rule, cream, and the sparkle.

becoming_pageturn: Five SwiftUI-native moves. (1) .scrollTransition on each page: the exiting page rotates 4-6 degrees around its leading edge while a 12 percent cocoa shadow gradient sweeps from the gutter, the light of a lifting sheet rather than a sliding tab. (2) Parallax: the photo or figure layer tracks at 0.85x of scroll while type tracks at 1.0x, so the type reads as printed on a sheet passing over the image plate. (3) The fore-edge lives on the trailing edge, vertical; the active tick stretches with a spring as the page settles, a thumb dragging the book's edge. (4) Tempo: .scrollTargetBehavior(.paging) with a long settle (spring response 0.5, damping 0.86) and one soft haptic at rest, roughly 450ms end to end, the weight of heavy stock falling shut. (5) Ink-second reveal: on settle the page's single large numeral blooms from 92 percent scale and zero opacity over 260ms while all type is already set, the way the eye lands on a printed number after the page turns.
one_move: Recompose Home as one bracketed frame: promote the kept line to a 64-72pt two-line monument with its 44-48pt seal in the top third, compress every number into a three-row didone ledger pinned at the foot, and strip the masthead to the date eyebrow alone (camera disc and hamburger deleted). That single recomposition, monument top, composed void middle, ledger foot, turns the front page from a well-set stats screen into the screenshot the brief demands, and its grammar becomes the template every other screen inherits.
